senses.gloss: ch. same, to guard, wait; to observe; to reserve.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 30:23">Targ. I Sam. XXX, 23</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 1:13">Targ. Ruth I, 13</cite>; a. fr.—Imper. <cite ref="I00700"><he>טַר</he></cite>, pl. <he>טְרוּ</he>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 27:1">Ib. XXVII, 1</cite> (Y. <he>טוּרוּ</he>); a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N00566"><he>נְטִיר</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="N00559"><he>נְטִירָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>נְטִירִין</he>; <cite ref="N00568"><he>נְטִירָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 9:24">Targ. I Sam. IX, 24</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 5:10">Targ. Y. Deut. V, 10</cite> <cite ref="N00566"><he>נְטִיר</he></cite> read: <cite ref="N00567"><he>נָטֵיר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a:6">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>נְטַר עד וכ׳</he> wait here until to-morrow.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:10">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 65a:8">65ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00339"><he>אַגְרָא</he> I</cite>.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 37a:2">Keth. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מְנַטְּרָא נפשה</he> (not <cite ref="M01784"><he>מינ׳</he></cite>) she guarded herself (her purity).—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 898">Yalk. Job 898</cite> <he>קמנטר תאני</he>, read as Ḥag. l. c. <cite ref="M01629"><he>מְנַקֵּיט</he></cite>.]—Part. pass. <he>מְנַטַּר</he>, f. <he>מְנַטְּרָא</he>, v. infra.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 12:14">Targ. Hos. XII, 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 24:11">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 15a:13">Bets. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>מִנְּטַר מחמת כלבי ולא מִינְטַר וכ׳</he> (or <he>מְנַטַּר</he>) Ms. M. (ed. <he>מְנַטְּרָא</he>) it is safe from dogs, but not from thieves.
Targ. Prov. VI, 22 (perh. to be read תִּנְטַר Pe.).

<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:5">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>הני מִינַּטְּרָן והני לא מִינַּטְּרָן</he> Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. <he>נטרן</he>, corr. acc.) these (the unripe figs) can be kept, but those (the ripe) cannot; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 898">Yalk. Job 898</cite> <he>מנטרן</he>.
